import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int inv(int n) {
        int e = MOD - 2, r = 1;
        long N = n;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) != 0) r = (int)((long) r * N % MOD);
            e >>= 1;
            N = (N * N) % MOD;
        }
        return r;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        int[][] P = new int[6][6];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                P[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            }
        }

        List<Integer> masks = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> masks2 = new ArrayList<>();
        int h = (n + 1) / 2;
        int h2 = n - h;
        int inv100 = inv(100);

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            int c = Integer.bitCount(i);
            if (c == h) masks.add(i);
            if (c == h2) masks2.add(i);
        }

        int sizeMasks = masks.size();

        long[] prob = new long[1 << sizeMasks];
        long[] prob2 = new long[1 << sizeMasks];

        // Process for masks
        int totalCells = n * h;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << totalCells); i++) {
            long p = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < totalCells; j++) {
                int x = j / n, y = j % n;
                if (((i >> j) & 1) != 0) {
                    p = (p * P[x][y] * inv100) % MOD;
                } else {
                    p = (p * (100 - P[x][y]) * inv100) % MOD;
                }
            }
            int poss = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < sizeMasks; j++) {
                List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if (((masks.get(j) >> k) & 1) != 0) v.add(k);
                }
                do {
                    int k;
                    for (k = 0; k < v.size(); k++) {
                        int a = k * n + v.get(k);
                        if (((i >> a) & 1) == 0) break;
                    }
                    if (k == v.size()) {
                        poss |= (1 << j);
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(v));
            }
            prob[poss] = (prob[poss] + p) % MOD;
        }

        // Process for masks2
        int totalCells2 = n * h2;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << totalCells2); i++) {
            long p = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < totalCells2; j++) {
                int x = j / n + h, y = j % n;
                if (((i >> j) & 1) != 0) {
                    p = (p * P[x][y] * inv100) % MOD;
                } else {
                    p = (p * (100 - P[x][y]) * inv100) % MOD;
                }
            }
            int poss = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < sizeMasks; j++) {
                List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if (((masks.get(j) >> k) & 1) == 0) v.add(k);
                }
                do {
                    int k;
                    for (k = 0; k < v.size(); k++) {
                        int a = k * n + v.get(k);
                        if (((i >> a) & 1) == 0) break;
                    }
                    if (k == v.size()) {
                        poss |= (1 << j);
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(v));
            }
            prob2[poss] = (prob2[poss] + p) % MOD;
        }

        // Inclusion-Exclusion on prob2
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeMasks; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << sizeMasks); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                    prob2[j] = (prob2[j] + prob2[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        int fullMask = (1 << sizeMasks) - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << sizeMasks); i++) {
            long val = (long) prob[i] * prob2[fullMask ^ i] % MOD;
            ans = (ans + val) % MOD;
        }

        long result = (MOD + 1 - ans) % MOD;
        System.out.println(result);
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> v) {
        int i = v.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && v.get(i) >= v.get(i + 1)) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = v.size() - 1;
        while (v.get(j) <= v.get(i)) j--;
        Collections.swap(v, i, j);
        int left = i + 1, right = v.size() - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            Collections.swap(v, left, right);
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
